name: AI Stock Image Metadata Generator
description: Generates title, description, and 20-40 keywords for stock photos using OpenAI Vision. Webhook-triggered, returns CSV-ready metadata.

setup: "Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, llm_system_9de8aada00.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /stock-image-meta). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Vision LLM" called the OpenAI API over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
